Anna borrowed a book about music from the museum. Last Saturday, Anna and Owen went to the repair shop. Anna wants to be a cook in the future. The washer lives in the utility room.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the repair shop by bike. Anna wrote about the day in the diary. The weather was cloudy that day. Also, stone pillars hold the market roof.
They took many photos at the library desk. Anna thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Both of them like noodles and tea. Best of all, an electric vehicle glided past silently.
Owen is interested in dancing. Anna learned a lot about music. Anna is going to travel to Toronto in September.
